## Offers (USD, one-time payment, every plan includes a brand book / libro de marca)
- Web Esencial: 150 USD — one-page landing, WhatsApp integration, basic SEO, essential brand book (logo, palette, fonts). Delivery 5–7 days.
- Web Pro: 350 USD — up to 6 pages, catalog, local SEO + Google Business Profile, blog/gallery, analytics, complete brand book. Delivery 10–15 days.
- Tu Web, Tu Presupuesto: custom scope based on the client's budget (online stores, bookings, CRM, systems, redesigns).
- Optional monthly hosting + maintenance. Domain and hosting are paid separately and owned by the client.
